name: fractal-glass
title: Fractal Glass
description: WebGL glass-strip refraction effect with fractal distortion, edge blending, and pointer-reactive parallax.

changelog.summary: Added a reduced-motion notice and removed a stray character left after a JSX comment.

props.name: stripesFrequency
props.description: Controls how many refractive glass strips are rendered.

props.name: glassStrength
props.description: Controls the intensity of the strip refraction.

props.name: glassSmoothness
props.description: Controls how smoothly neighboring refraction samples blend.

props.name: distortionMultiplier
props.description: Amplifies parallax around distorted stripe regions.

props.name: edgePadding
props.description: Softens distortion near the media edges.
